say:1:1230109001:1.text: I heard that the fishmongers in town have pelagic fish in stock.
say:1:1230109001:1.source_cn: 我听说城里的鱼贩那里有远海鱼卖。

say:2:1230109002:1.text: We here can't go out to sea because of the thick fog. It puzzles me how they get their hands on those fish.
say:2:1230109002:1.source_cn: 大雾使得渔船无法出航，真不知道他们是从哪里搞来的远海鱼。

choice_prompt:3:1230109002.text: We here can't go out to sea because of the thick fog. It puzzles me how they get their hands on those fish.

say:4:1230109003:1.text: Me? How could I have any when the prices of those fish have soared sky-high, courtesy of those fishmongers in town!
say:4:1230109003:1.source_cn: 我？怎么可能？远海鱼已经被那群城里的鱼贩炒到了天价！
